shapes.rules: One or two representative inputs. Assert the exact return value, never its type or its count.
Empty input, one element, and the value either side of each limit. One test per boundary, exact values.

functions.name: truncate
functions.signature: Strings.truncate(_ text: String, maxLength: Int) -> String
functions.notes: The one-character ellipsis counts towards maxLength, so a cut string is exactly maxLength characters long. maxLength <= 0 gives "".

functions.name: countOccurrences
functions.signature: Strings.countOccurrences(_ haystack: String, _ needle: String) -> Int
functions.notes: Non-overlapping: "aaa" contains "aa" once. An empty needle counts as none.

functions.name: commonPrefix
functions.signature: Strings.commonPrefix(_ a: String, _ b: String) -> String
functions.notes: Character-wise; returns "" when the first characters differ, and the whole of the shorter string when one is a prefix of the other.
